<a id="coming-to-be-and-ceasing-to-be-keep-pace--开始成立与不再成立同步"></a>
# Coming to be and ceasing to be keep pace

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`coming-and-ceasing-keep-pace` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](coming-and-ceasing-keep-pace.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> In a finite family whose counted determination is decided, coming to be and ceasing to be keep pace; this needs no premise about the unfolding.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. The following hold of every web, with no premise about it. A determination comes to be across a step where it fails before and holds after, and ceases to be where it holds before and fails after; a formation arising and ceasing, a dependence forming and dissolving, and a condition coming to stand and ceasing to stand are this one change, read of activity, dependence and standing. (`Becoming.ComesToBe`, `Becoming.CeasesToBe`, `Becoming.Web.Ceases`, `Becoming.Web.CeasesToStand`, `Becoming.Web.change_readings`)
2. A decidable determination that holds and ceases to be at no later step holds on; a formation supported at one step is supported at another where each dependence it has at the other it had at the first, at no greater need, on a condition standing no lower. (`Becoming.persists`, `Becoming.Web.Supported`, `Becoming.Web.supported_of`)
3. Over any stretch of steps, an amount at the end with everything it fell is the amount at the start with everything it rose, and so for the total of a finite family with the rises and falls of its members. (`Becoming.rise`, `Becoming.fall`, `Becoming.over_stretch`, `Becoming.family_over_stretch`)
4. No amount falls below zero, so over a stretch a finite family falls by at most its total at the start more than it rises, and members falling at arbitrarily late steps rise at arbitrarily late steps: in every unfolding, levels of finitely many conditions that keep falling keep rising. (`Becoming.fallen_within`, `Becoming.rising_recurs`, `Becoming.Web.falls_need_rises`)
5. For one amount this is Becoming.Renewal's law that an observable never rising from some step on does not fall at arbitrarily late steps. (`Becoming.falls_not_recurring`)
6. With the amounts bounded, the family rises by at most its bound per member more than it falls, and rising at arbitrarily late steps needs falling at arbitrarily late steps. (`Becoming.risen_within`, `Becoming.falling_recurs`)
7. A determination counts as zero or one, so both hold of it: over any stretch, the members of a finite family holding at the end with those that ceased to be are those holding at the start with those that came to be; comings and ceasings differ by at most the number of members; and each recurs exactly when the other does. (`Becoming.mark`, `Becoming.held_over_stretch`, `Becoming.keep_pace`, `Becoming.coming_recurs_iff`)
8. Read of activity, given decidable activity: the members of a finite family of formations active at the end with those that ceased are those active at the start with those that arose; they arise at arbitrarily late steps exactly when they cease at arbitrarily late steps; and with finitely many formations, arising recurs exactly when ceasing does. (`Becoming.held_over_stretch`, `Becoming.Web.arising_recurs_iff`, `Becoming.Web.Unceasing`, `Becoming.Web.unceasing_iff`)
9. Read of standing, with no premise at all: conditions of a finite family come to stand at arbitrarily late steps exactly when they cease to stand at arbitrarily late steps. (`Becoming.Web.ComesToStand`, `Becoming.Web.standing_recurs_iff`)
10. Finiteness does the work: ever new formations can arise with none ceasing while a level rises at every step and never falls (Accretion), and formations all active at the start can cease one after another while nothing arises (Attrition). (`Becoming.Accretion.web`, `Becoming.Accretion.unceasing`, `Becoming.Accretion.never_ceases`, `Becoming.Accretion.rises`, `Becoming.Accretion.never_falls`, `Becoming.Attrition.web`, `Becoming.Attrition.ceasing`, `Becoming.Attrition.nothing_arises`)
11. The activity law holds of every world in a local form: where one list covers the active formations from some step on and activity is decided, arising recurs exactly when ceasing does; finitely many formations in all is not needed, and Web.unceasing_iff is its corollary. (`Becoming.Web.unceasing_iff_covering`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Commitments of the representation, not premises about the unfolding: change is read across discrete steps; amounts are natural numbers; counting needs the counted determination to be decidable at each step (decidable activity is a hypothesis of the theorems that use it; whether a level is positive is always decidable, so standing_recurs_iff needs none).
- The family is finite, given as a list, possibly with repetition; Accretion and Attrition show that both directions fail for infinite families. That recurring rises need recurring falls also needs the amounts bounded; a determination counts zero or one, so it always is.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Recurring means occurring at arbitrarily late steps and gives no frequency.
- Keeping pace is of counts and says neither which formations arise or cease nor why.
- Formal laws are not taken for the deductive necessity of the whole for reality.
- That the three readings are one change is no fact beyond the definitions: change_readings holds by unfolding them (six Iff.rfl); the checked content is keeping pace in a finite family. Witness: `Becoming.Web.change_readings`.
- **Counterexample:** An infinite family: ever new formations arise with none ceasing, while a level rises at every step and never falls (Accretion). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Change.lean)
- **Counterexample:** An infinite family: formations all active at the start cease one after another while nothing arises (Attrition). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Change.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · Uses decidability of the named determinations, a logical commitment written as a hypothesis. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Ren's proposal: counting the whole space, generative and degenerative, the theory of becoming may need no axiom, and adding axioms defines a part of the whole space (2026-10-08-theory-of-becoming-priority). This result gives a set of laws holding of the whole space: they hold of every web, with no assumption about it, while the laws of the earlier modules (under Dependent, Balances, Dissipative, Embodied, Carries) name their premises. The one the author finds most contentful: in a finite family, coming to be and ceasing to be keep pace, arising is unceasing exactly when ceasing is, and coming to stand exactly when ceasing to stand. The author reads this as one formal content of Ren's scope, formation, persistence, transformation, degeneration and dissolution within one unfolding (an AI argument): in a finite family there is no unceasing arising without unceasing ceasing, and no unceasing ceasing without unceasing arising; arising without ceasing needs ever new formations (Accretion), and ceasing without arising needs endlessly many at the start (Attrition). This is a reading of activity, arising and ceasing being names Ren confirmed (2026-10-09-arising-ceasing-names); it is not the proposal's generative and degenerative (Ren wrote ‘generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧’, a tag question presuming that they do not overlap, so this reading is not what is meant; they read as widening and narrowing what can form, DELEGATED-CHOICES D2): coming to be and ceasing to be keep pace here in a finite family; for the reading as relations see Web.renewing_not_consuming. The Chinese terms proposed for ceasing and coming to be are the AI's, adopted under Ren's naming rule (DELEGATED-CHOICES D36).

**Law family:** The census and the laws of counting (lead: [census-balance](census-balance.md)). What comes to be and what ceases are counted against one list: the list at the end with what ceased is the list at the start with what came. The members state that balance and its halves (ceasing needs arising; under a continuation, a bounded census and enclosure), where the counts exist (where what they count is decided), the census read off the exchange, and what the premises add to the tally.
